parent_objective: localize role-specific scorecard blockers before repair ranking or paper claims
blocked_by: M1784 keeps ranking blocked and requires no-rollout blocker localization
supersedes: global scorecard ranking without role/blocker localization

public_gates: M1785 must use only M1783 scorecard artifacts and must not rerun reset or rollout
M1785 must localize blockers by role profile hidden dynamics bucket sampled label and primary metric
M1785 must preserve diagnostic-only no-ranking semantics
M1785 must decide whether to route to scenario/metric repair branch synthesis or a tightly scoped role-specific comparison design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: localizes role-specific scorecard blockers before deciding repair or synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout diagnostic localization only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if localization cannot identify dominant blockers
stop if localization requires new rollout before existing artifacts are exhausted
stop if localization starts ranking profiles instead of diagnosing blockers
stop if branch synthesis cadence or blocker ambiguity requires synthesis
fallback_plan: route to metric-contract repair if blockers are metric artifacts
route to scenario/panel repair if blockers are panel artifacts
route to branch synthesis if scorecard evidence is exhausted without ranking admission
route to narrow comparison design only if localization finds a defensible role-specific surface
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1784 blocks ranking and admits blocker localization

admission_evidence: M1784 audits M1783 extraction as complete but not ranking-admissible
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1785 no-rollout localization artifacts or document
M1785 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for repair synthesis or scoped comparison design
next_stage_criteria: dominant blockers are localized or explicitly declared diffuse
ranking remains blocked unless a narrow comparison surface is explicitly admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; blocker localization is task-quality metric processing.
history_necessity_tests: Localization must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If blockers are diffuse or no role is admissible, record that and route to repair or synthesis rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1783 scorecard blockers can be localized from existing artifacts well enough to choose a repair, synthesis, or narrow comparison route without rerunning rollout.
success_criteria: M1785 localization artifact or document exists
M1785 uses only M1783 scorecard artifacts
M1785 localizes or declares diffuse blockers by role profile hidden dynamics bucket sampled label and primary metric
M1785 makes the next route explicit
failure_criteria: localization ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: localize
commands.command: localize M1783 role-specific scorecard blockers without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1785 passes if it localizes blockers from existing scorecards and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
